msg: I would recommend that you choose the gnome with the taller, more narrow shaped hat. I found this gnome offers the highest number of mushrooms as a general rule of thumb.However, if you notice the number of mushrooms dropping below 5 by picking this gnome, then I suggest you start picking the other gnome with the larger, rounder shaped head. I didn't notice much correlation between the colours of the gnomes. I found the best way to pick the gnome which provided the most mushrooms was to pick based on physical size of the head, as opposed to the colour.
